item.title: Lab Wins Two Awards at 2026 Bionic Design Competition
item.description: The lab received two awards in the College & Youth Innovation category (大專暨青創組) at the 2026 Bionic Design Competition (仿生設計競賽). The mudskipper-inspired design received the Marine Sustainability Innovation Award (海洋永續創新獎) from the Ocean Conservation Administration, Ocean Affairs Council, while the silkmoth-inspired robot, drawing on the silkmoth’s odour-sensing abilities, received the Circular Economy Smart Reduction Award (循環經濟智慧減量獎) from the Environmental Protection Department, New Taipei City Government.

item.title: Moth-Inspired Robot Places Fifth in Biomimetic Robotics
item.description: The lab’s silk moth-inspired robot placed fifth in the Biomimetic Robotics category at the 2026 Bionic Design Competition (仿生設計競賽). Inspired by the silkmoth’s odour-sensing abilities, the robot explores bio-inspired approaches to robotic sensing.

item.title: Qi-Sheng Huang Earns Honourable Mention at CSME Conference
item.description: At this year’s CSME Conference, Qi-Sheng Huang received an Honourable Mention (佳作) in the student paper competition for research supervised by Dr Lan. The study applied the silkmoth’s tracking behaviour to robotic guidance and control, achieving improved efficiency and accuracy through a nature-inspired approach.

item.title: Dr Lan's Team Unveils 3 Cutting-Edge Research at AMAM Conference
item.description: Dr Lan and his team presented research on aerodynamics and odour tracking at the 11th International Symposium on Adaptive Motion of Animals and Machines (AMAM) in Kobe. Their work contributed new insights into the interaction between animal locomotion and engineering technology.
